name: quark-drive
description: Seamlessly upload large files (too big for GitHub) to Quark Drive through the official Quark agent CLI for multi-device sync. The agent decides when to upload on its own (>=50MB artifacts, sync/backup intent, .quark-manifest entries); files land in one standardized cloud folder (来自ZCode/) and real repos leave AGENTS-quark.md hints plus a declarative .quark-manifest so any device can re-login and restore missing resources with a single restore command. Auto-installs the official CLI on first use (OAuth login per device), with a local ledger plus cloud search for retrieval.
